items.h: Rhode Island's 2026 Christmas Season Events Guide
items.sum: Dates, times and prices for Trinity Rep, Cirque du Soleil, the Boston Pops, The Nutcracker, the Newport mansions, tree lightings and light displays statewide.

items.h: Ringing in 2027: Rhode Island's New Year's Eve guide
items.sum: Noon countdowns, Providence's riverfront fireworks, tasting dinners, black-tie balls, live bands and comedy across the state on Thursday, Dec. 31.

items.h: Thanksgiving in Rhode Island: the 2026 guide
items.sum: Turkey trots, community meals, places to volunteer, Thanksgiving Masses and about 30 restaurants serving dinner on Thursday, Nov. 26.

items.h: Chorus of Westerly Rings In the Season With Vaughan Williams' Hodie
items.sum: Saturday, November 14 at 6 p.m. and Sunday, November 15 at 3 p.m. at George Kent Performance Hall in Westerly.

items.h: Providence Singers Sing American Voices in Warren and Providence
items.sum: Choral concerts Nov. 21 in Warren and Nov. 22 in Providence, with Copland, folk songs and a bluegrass Mass.

items.h: Sheila Isham: Between Worlds at the Newport Art Museum Through Jan. 4
items.sum: Open Monday and Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., at the Newport Art Museum, 76 Bellevue Avenue, Newport, with the exhibition running through Jan. 4, 2027.

items.h: Environmental Currents: Art and Ocean Science at URI's Studio Blue
items.sum: Open Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., at Studio Blue on URI's Narragansett Bay Campus in Narragansett, through Nov. 18, with no charge admission.

items.h: Holiday Premiere: Handmade Gifts at WaterFire Arts Center
items.sum: A day of local makers, coffee and food trucks, with no-charge admission on Sunday, Nov. 15.

items.h: Stargazing Fridays at Frosty Drew Observatory
items.sum: Telescopes, the Sky Theatre and astronomers on Friday nights in Charlestown, weather permitting.

items.h: Armenian Fest Returns to Rhodes on the Pawtuxet in Cranston
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 14, noon to 8 p.m., and Sunday, Nov. 15, noon to 7 p.m., at Sts. Vartanantz Armenian Apostolic Church's Rhodes on the Pawtuxet, 60 Rhodes Place, Cranston.

items.h: Almost, Maine Brings Northern Lights Romance to West Warwick
items.sum: The Arctic Playhouse stages John Cariani's comedy on evenings and Sunday afternoons through Nov. 22.

items.h: Newport Classical Adds a Piano Debut and Guitar to November
items.sum: Two Friday concerts at the Recital Hall, Nov. 6 and Nov. 20, bring a new pianist and Spanish and Latin guitar music.

items.h: Blithewold's Expressions of Nature Reception Set for Nov. 15
items.sum: Family programs on Nov. 7 and a gallery reception on Nov. 15 fill a busy fall stretch at the Bristol estate.

items.h: RISD's Photography Department Triennial is on view in Providence
items.sum: Work from the department is at Woods-Gerry Gallery through Nov. 15, after a Nov. 5 reception.

items.h: RISD's Illustration faculty show opens at the ISB Gallery
items.sum: Work by Illustration faculty is on view Nov. 6 through Dec. 4 at One Washington Place.

items.h: Joe Parillo and the New Ensemble Bring Lily Pads Jazz to Peace Dale
items.sum: Sunday, Nov. 15, doors at 3 p.m. and the show from 3:30 to 5:30 p.m., at the Unitarian Universalist Congregation of South County in Peace Dale.

items.h: Newport Restaurant Week runs Nov. 6–15 with fixed-price menus
items.sum: Participating Newport restaurants offer special lunch and dinner menus through Nov. 15.

items.h: Happy Mail: Jamestown Library Makes Thank-You Postcards on Nov. 14
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 14, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. in the Sydney Wright Room of the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, Jamestown.

items.h: Rusty Pens: A Weekly Writing Workshop for Jamestown Beginners
items.sum: Mondays from Nov. 9 through Feb. 22, 10:30 to 11:30 a.m., in the Sydney Wright Room of the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, Jamestown.

items.h: An Evening on Abstract Art in Newport
items.sum: A guided Nov. 18 program at the Newport Art Museum pairs Sheila Isham's exhibition with close-looking exercises.

items.h: Round Panels Open at Jamestown Arts Center
items.sum: Molly Kugler Dickinson's Of Longing and Loss opens with a Nov. 20 reception and runs through Jan. 9.

items.h: Young Performers Take the Mic in Westerly
items.sum: Youth On the Mic brings student singers and musicians to The Knick Music Lab on Sunday, Nov. 22, with no charge for admission.

items.h: RISD Museum Traces 150 Years of Collecting
items.sum: In the Making opens Nov. 21 and shows how the museum's works arrived, on view through Aug. 1, 2027.

items.h: Gamm Stages Arthur Miller's A View From the Bridge This November
items.sum: This November at the Gamm Theatre in Warwick, with dates and curtain times listed on the theatre's season page.

items.h: RIC Chorus Sings Carols and Light in Sapinsley Hall on Nov. 13
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 13 at 7:30 p.m. in Sapinsley Hall at the Nazarian Center, 115 First Avenue, Providence, with paid admission.

items.h: Everybody Chorus Welcomes Jamestown Singers of All Ages
items.sum: An informal, all-ages singing hour meets at the Jamestown Recreation Center on Nov. 14.

items.h: A Dying Tree Becomes Art at Weaver Library
items.sum: Sculptor Anthony Heinz May turns dying or fallen trees into art, which he calls shared authorship.

items.h: Newport's Illuminated Boat Parade Returns Nov. 27
items.sum: The 27th annual harbor parade can be watched at no charge, and a non-perishable food donation is requested.

items.h: Jane Pickens Brings Ski Films by Warren Miller and Teton Gravity Research
items.sum: Three snowsport film screenings are set in Newport this month, starting at 7:30 p.m.

items.h: Salve's Ochre Court Opens Season 4 of The Gilded Age
items.sum: The Richard Morris Hunt mansion doubles as a castle in the season premiere, with Salve students among the extras.

items.h: The Nutcracker Dances Into Woonsocket's Stadium Theatre
items.sum: Heritage Ballet performs three matinee and evening shows Nov. 28 and 29.

items.h: Bye Bye Birdie Opens the Community Players' Season
items.sum: The Pawtucket theatre group stages the 1960 musical at Jenks Auditorium, Nov. 13 to 22.

items.h: Trinity Rep Marks 50 Years of A Christmas Carol
items.sum: The Providence company's golden-anniversary production plays Nov. 5 through Dec. 31 in the Dowling Theater.

items.h: Dave Matthews Band Plays Amica Mutual Pavilion Tonight
items.sum: Monday's Providence show is the fourth stop on the band's seven-date fall run.

items.h: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Dave Matthews, LEGO and Bobcats
items.sum: Monday's best picks, with a LEGO club at 3 p.m. and a Bobcat talk at 6 p.m.

items.h: Jamestown Arts Center Opens Its 2026 Members' Show
items.sum: Reception Friday, Nov. 20, 5:30 to 7:30 p.m.; on view through Jan. 9, 2027.

items.h: Museum Reads Turns to Paul Gauguin in Newport
items.sum: Thursday, Nov. 19 at noon, in person at the museum or on Zoom.

items.h: Jamestown Community Theatre Opens Merrily We Roll Along
items.sum: Performances Nov. 19 through 22, with a Sondheim musical told in reverse.

items.h: Local Makers Fill the Stadium Theatre for a Holiday Market
items.sum: Saturday, Nov. 14, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., in Woonsocket, with raffles and a book swap.

items.h: Jazz students play Ellington at the Greenwich Odeum
items.sum: The East Greenwich High School Jazz Ensemble performs Duke Ellington and Billy Strayhorn on Wednesday, Nov. 18, with no charge admission.

items.h: A holiday pageant takes the stage in Westerly
items.sum: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever runs daily at the Granite Theatre from Nov. 27 through Dec. 20.
